title: What if a giant sinkhole appeared downtown? #shorts
description:
Rush hour at a busy crossing. Then the road sinks a few centimeters… and the whole crossing drops away.

The facts: in 2010 a sinkhole about 20 m wide and roughly 90–100 m deep opened in the middle of Guatemala City, most likely after leaking pipes washed away loose volcanic soil. In 1981 a sinkhole in Winter Park, Florida grew to about 100 m across. And the Xiaozhai Tiankeng in China is more than 500 m deep.

What do you think is under your street? 👇
